approximations: No physical box was measured and no Nintendo factory die drawing was available.
Board gauges, score radii, glue-lap widths, tongue lengths, flap clearances and tray folds are artist-authored approximations informed by photographs.
Tray apertures are fitted to the existing visualization cartridge envelopes, not a certified manufacturing tolerance.
Hinges model paper as rigid articulated panels. Their Open endpoints are display poses rather than a deformation simulation.
The NES foam material uses subtle procedural source shading; exported material retains clean base color.
No manuals, posters, shrinkwrap or cartridge/disc models are included. The early NES integrated hangtab remains flush in the ordinary Open pose and can be raised separately.
rights: Only original geometry and authored metadata are distributed here. Reference URLs are attribution/evidence links; reference photographs and logos are not redistributed by this module.
